_comment: preview.coo.ee's TRUSTED PRODUCERS — deployment config for one specific box, NOT image content. Kept out of deploy/image/trust/ deliberately: baking these made every adopter of the prebuilt image inherit trust in nine repos, which on a box with SERVE_ALLOW_RENDER_TRUSTED=1 is eligibility for server-side execution of those repos' Compose. Changes on main are applied directly by publish-preview-config.yml; image publishes reconcile the same file as a fallback. Both paths use .github/scripts/publish-config-to-box.sh via POST /admin/trust. Must cover every catalog in catalogs.json beside this file, or that catalog serves as `unverified` — and, since --catalog-registry, every catalog a nominated registry contributes too: a registry's catalogs are not normally listed in catalogs.json at all, so nothing there will remind you — though while the registry path is not reaching this box, two of them (joreilly-peopleinspace, joreilly-climatetracekmp) ARE enumerated there as a bridge, and the rest still are not. yschimke/compose-preview-imports is such a registry, and is the one entry whose branch CONTENT is built from third-party projects: read it as trust in the import review (a pull request naming the upstream repo, ref and modules) plus the pipeline that renders it, not in the upstream projects. It grants no execution today because an import delivery branch carries no executable payload (joreilly-peopleinspace's catalog.json has no liveBundle and no webRender) — but on a box running SERVE_ALLOW_RENDER_TRUSTED=1 it would the moment the import pipeline started publishing one, so revisit it then rather than inheriting it silently.
